generate_protobuf_bindings: run python setup.py generate_protos to compile all dm_alchemy proto files into Python and gRPC bindings
build_python_package: run python setup.py build_py to build the dm_alchemy package with auto-generated protobuf bindings
build_extensions: run python setup.py build_ext to build C extensions and generate protobuf bindings in one step
install_dm_alchemy: run python setup.py install to install the dm-alchemy package and all dependencies into the current environment
run_tests: run python setup.py test to execute the nose test suite for the dm-alchemy package
